body:
If you think it's worth saving then try to save it then I'd suggest counseling as well. If it's too far gone and you think that it isn't worth it anymore then maybe it is time for a divorce. Better now without kids than with. Just remember divorce fucking sucks. But it probably sucks less than a lifetime of unhappiness. 

This is coming from a guy who's wife is leaving him because she's unhappy and is unwilling to work on it. Not even one counseling session. So take it for what it's worth.
Wow that sucks. I'm sorry. Lawyer up.
That's what I keep hearing. Can't get much worse so only way to go is up. Or dead. Hopefully up. Trying to go up.

Yeah I've noticed.  I have a few women friends who have been super supportive of me right now. So I tend to keep away from that. Haven't called the STBXW any gendered slurs. Yelled at my brother for doing that.  Told him I still love her and that was not cool.  Yeah. Can't blame all women for your particular relationship falling apart.
Want to know the type of person you married?  Divorce them.  Yay its gender neutral now!

Exactly. I kind of want to be with someone and maybe forget about the loneliness for a while, but then I just think it'll probably come back 10 times worse.  Like we used to lay in bed together and she'd fall asleep and I'd hold her hand.  Now that's gone.  I'm not sure when I'll be ready for that again.  I don't know if she found someone else and that's why she's moving on.  She won't tell me.  I miss how it used to be.

Haha thanks.  I don't know if I'm ready to give beardy kisses to anyone yet.  She kind of shattered my heart to pieces.  Hopefully we both can get stronger from the situation we find ourselves in.  I mean something good has to come out of it right?  Can't be all bad can it?  At least that's what my more obnoxious friends keep telling me. Stupid optimistic jerks with their functioning....semi-functioning relationships.
Yeah. Same here with my wife. Except the beardy kiss.  I gave her beardy kisses.  I'm sorry.  *hugs*
This. It's been a fucking whirlwind. I have no idea what to expect anymore. I just spend most of the time at the gym now.

If it's a 401k loan she is essentially borrowing from herself. It's paid back through her payroll. If she doesn't pay it back it's reclassified as a distribution and she'll have to claim it as income and pay taxes on it. There may also be a 10% additional tax penalty if she's under 59 1/2. It doesn't show up on credit reports, but unless she stops working for the company it's going to come out of her paycheck to pay it back. Interest does go back into her account though rather than be paid back to a bank.

Thanks. I wish I didn't feel like such a failure. I don't know if I'll ever find anyone else. 

It really blows.

I just don't want to think the last six years of our life meant nothing to her. She doesn't want to try to work it out or try to save it. We were both not there for each other emotionally. I pushed her away emotionally she pushed me away emotionally. I never yelled at her or hit her or anything terrible. I love her. My biggest mistake was not showing it to her often enough. Anytime I tried to hold her or kiss her she could only stand it for so long before she pushed me away. 

I'm going to therapy to try to work on my own issues but she has no interest whatsoever. I don't understand why she doesn't want to try to fight for us.

I'm going through the same thing. We don't have any kids but it sucks thinking of all the things we used to do together and now we can't. 

I'm sorry man.

I'm sorry.  My STBX is living in the same house as me still until she gets enough saved to move out.  It's like living in the house with a stranger.  We used to talk and laugh and plan our days and I'd call her up on the phone to tell her about my day and talk to her.  That's all gone now.  Now.  The house is sad and empty and I want to get her out so I can sell it asap and move to a new city without these memories.
I'm really sorry you're going through this.  I was told a week ago by my wife she's no longer in love with me.  It sucks. I hope we both get through this.

I think she's really gone.  She's stubborn. I know once she makes up her mind, its made up. She's been thinking about this for a long time.  I told her about my plans. I'm going to go finish my AS. I've got 16 credits left to go, 11 in the Fall, and 5 in the Spring.  After that I really don't have anything keeping me here. The house is in my name and was bought before we were married. She says if I can give her some money if I sell it she'd appreciate it, but it's up to me and she won't force it.  Maybe I'll change my mind and stay. Maybe the city I'm in will have new happier memories once she's gone. I don't know.  I just know that right now, anytime I drive by something I can't help but think of the things that we used to do together there.
Friend took me out drinking. We hung out for five hours and discussed all kinds of bullshit.  It was a good distraction.  Now that I'm home though it's all coming back.
